description: Work out print document sizes. Pass `trim_width` and `trim_height` with `unit` (mm, cm, in, pt), optional `bleed` (default 3 mm; the common European figure, US printers often ask 0.125 in = 3.18 mm), `safe` margin inside trim (default 5 mm), and for books `pages` (counted as printed pages, 2 per leaf), `caliper` (thickness of ONE sheet of the paper) with `caliper_unit` (microns, mm, mil = thousandth of an inch, which paper trade calls points, or in), `spine_extra_mm` for glue allowance, and `binding` (perfect, saddle, none). Formulas: size with bleed = trim + 2 x bleed; safe area = trim - 2 x safe; spine = (pages / 2) x caliper + extra; cover spread width = 2 x trim width + spine + 2 x bleed. Spine is an estimate: the printer's own template and paper stock win, and hardcover case binding adds board thickness not computed here.

bleed.description: Bleed in the same unit (default 3 mm)

safe.description: Safe margin in the same unit (default 5 mm)

name: calc_print_spec
title: Print spec calculator
